mathematical_audit.exact_carrier: after omitting exact-zero cofactor rows, saturation by a sufficiently high power of t removes precisely the t-supported prime factors, and intersecting with rad(Q) gives the actual R_perp,Q
mathematical_audit.first_hit_split: assigning each surviving prime to its earliest depth makes the D_j pairwise coprime, with product R_perp,Q and sum log D_j equal to Xi_Q
mathematical_audit.mesoscopic_localization: |z_j|<A^2 implies that each D_j supported above A is either 1 or one distinct prime A<p<A^2; primes at most A contribute theta(A)=O(A)=o(log b)
mathematical_audit.density_necessity: each depth contributes at most 2 log A, so Xi_Q at rate eta forces at least (eta/2+o(1))n active depths, while every o(n)-depth portfolio is zero rate

mathematical_audit.scope_warning: the raw product contains exact-zero components and the theorem does not control the specialization-first average, growing zero-pattern stratification, or the actual mesoscopic first-hit distribution
